Die 3D-aero GmbH ist ein Tech-Unternehmen aus Hamburg mit etwa 70 Mitarbeitenden und ist seit Dezember 2024 ein stolzer Teil der MTU Aero Engines AG – einem der weltweit führenden Unternehmen der Luftfahrtindustrie. Wir entwickeln kundenspezifische Automatisierungslösungen für die Flugzeugproduktion und andere Industriebereiche. Dabei nutzen wir optische Sensorik und moderne Industrieroboter zusammen mit KI-basierter Datenverarbeitung, um maßgeschneiderte Systeme für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln.
Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen SPS-Programmierer (gn) für Sondermaschinen und Roboteranlagen . Wenn Dich der Themenbereich rund um Robotik und Sonderanlagenbau begeistert, dann bist Du hier richtig. Bewirb Dich und werde Teil des 3D-aero-Teams!
Aufgaben
Du entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Steuerungsprogramme für unsere Sondermaschinen und Roboteranlagen – überwiegend mit dem Siemens TIA Portal und bringst dabei eigene Ideen in die Entwicklung ein.
Du sorgst mit modernen Visualisierungssystemen, bspw. WinCC, für eine benutzerfreundliche Bedienung unserer Anlagen.
Du begleitest spannende Projekte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg - von der Konzeptphase über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Abnahme beim Kunden im In- und Ausland.
Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Konstruktion, Projektmanagement und Inbetriebnahme zusammen, um optimale Lösungen zu realisieren.
Du analysierst bestehende Steuerungsprogramme, entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter und unterstützt bei der Fehlerdiagnose sowie der nachhaltigen Störungsbehebung.

Security Clearance Type: None/Not Required Security Clearance Status: Not Required At RTX , the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems.

With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Are you a dynamic leader with a passion for Avionics? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your technical expertise can make a real difference? At Collins Aerospace in Cedar Rapids, IA, we're looking for a Pr. Software Engineer to join our foundation software team.

You'll be leading the development, certification, and sustainment of foundation software for safety-critical military applications. In this role, you'll be responsible for managing the impacts to foundation software due to hardware obsolescence and customer driven changes to fielded products.

The scope of this effort includes military avionics components utilizing PowerPC based systems using LynxOS-178 operating system. The components include processing modules, ethernet nodes, commercial and high integrity ethernet switch modules. This role requires the ability to analyze requirements, software, and open problem reports.

This role will also require you to manage small development teams when software updates are required. What YOU Will Do: Lead Projects: You will serve as the software project engineer, supplying project management and technical direction during all program phases including pursuit, bidding, planning, execution, and sustainment.

Ensure Consistency: You will ensure consistency with Collins Aerospace technical engineering processes. Define Development Plans: You will help define development plans, ensure compliance with DO-178 and other certification requirements, and lead certification efforts through audits.

Guide Teams: You will lead a wide range of entry-level to highly experienced engineers. Communicate Effectively: You will communicate technical progress, risks, opportunities, financial data, and other project management information clearly and concisely.

What YOU Will Learn: Technical Expertise: You will enhance your technical skills in processing platforms and associated technologies. Leadership Skills: You will develop your ability to lead and manage software development teams, making impactful decisions and solving complex problems.

Qualifications You Must Have: Embedded C and Foundation Level Software Experience.

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience Qualifications We Prefer: We value teamwork and team players, those who know how to work with others to accomplish a goal, and those who mentor and grow other engineers.

We value people who demonstrate initiative, a strong desire to learn and grow, tenacity in completing tasks and meeting commitments, and an ability to adapt to change. We value people who show energy in their work. We value proactive self-starters who build sound, collaborative relationships.

We value leadership in every role you have, the ability to guide people and break down barriers to success.

At Serko, we believe something incredible happens when people come face-to-face. That’s why we’re on a mission to engineer a frictionless, next-generation business travel marketplace. We don’t just manage travel; we are leveraging advanced AI and cutting-edge tech to eliminate the complexity of global movement.

When you join Serko, you join a global collective of passionate technologists who show up as their true selves to build world-class products. With established hubs across New Zealand, Australia, North America, India and China - your code and ideas will impact millions of corporate travelers worldwide.

If you're ready to challenge the status quo and build the future of travel tech, your next journey starts here. We’re hiring 2 x Senior Full Stack Engineer to own the end-to-end development of our next-gen AI products.

Requirements You'll bridge the gap between complex AI capabilities and beautiful user experiences, developing the customer-facing features, high-performance APIs, and reliable backend services that make intelligent, autonomous workflows reality.

What You’ll Do Build Meaningful Experiences: Partner closely with a cross-functional team of designers, product managers, and ML engineers to shape and deliver thoughtful, high-quality AI-powered user experiences.

Bridge Frontend & Backend: Co-create and refine full-stack features, utilizing React/Next.js for intuitive frontends and Python or Node.js to power robust, reliable backend services.

Bring AI to Life: Integrate LLM APIs and innovative agentic frameworks into fluid product features—crafting interactive streaming UIs, clear tool-call results, and helpful agent status displays.

Design Accessible Connections: Cultivate and maintain clean REST and/or GraphQL APIs that seamlessly support user data, smooth session management, and helpful agent interactions.

Champion Quality Together: Write thoughtful unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure product excellence, and engage in constructive, supportive code reviews that help the whole team grow.

Support Team Resilience: Contribute to a shared, collaborative on-call rotation, working as a team to support production systems, document thoughtful learnings, and keep our platform running smoothly.

Shape Our Technical Future: Share your unique perspective in architectural discussions and contribute technical proposals that help our systems scale sustainably. ﻿What you'll bring A Passion for Full-Stack & AI: Deep, hands-on experience building full-stack applications, with a special focus on native AI stack development.

Core Technical Comfort: A strong foundational comfort with TypeScript (React, Next.js) on the front end, paired with Python and SQL on the backend. AI Integration Experience: Experience successfully bringing AI to life in production, specifically by integrating with LLM APIs or crafting intuitive AI-powered features.

Thoughtful System Design: A clear understanding of RESTful API design, database management (such as PostgreSQL or Redis), and cloud ecosystems. An Eye for Real-Time UX: Familiarity with creating smooth, real-time user experiences using streaming responses (like SSE or WebSockets) so our AI feels fluid and responsive.

DevOps Awareness: Comfort collaborating on continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), containerization (Docker), and smooth cloud deployments. Empathetic Communication: Highly developed communication skills and a natural ability to listen, share ideas, and partner effectively within a cross-functional team.

Nice to Have If you have experience in any of these areas, that’s wonderful! If not, we are excited to support your learning on the job: Familiarity with agentic frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph. Exposure to building vector search or RAG-based capabilities.

A background or interest in crafting interactive interfaces like chat, copilots, or workflow automation tools. Benefits At Serko, we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work.

This means you’ll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high-quality and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact.

Some of the benefits of working at Serko are: A competitive base pay Medical Benefits Discretionary incentive plan based on individual and company performance Focus on development: Access to a learning & development platform and opportunity for you to own your career pathways Flexible work policy The pay range is between $152,000 - $230,000 USD as a base salary offering annually.

A Note on Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. At this time, we are unable to provide sponsorship or assume sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status). Originally posted on Himalayas

The PingOne Platform Administration team focuses on creating seamless PingOne experiences and onboarding experiences that help prospects explore PingOne quickly and transition smoothly into production use.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact platform and developer experience initiatives at the intersection of identity, cloud services, and emerging AI-enabled workflows.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our Agile software development team focused on evolving the PingOne Platform Administration space and supporting the development of AI-adjacent platform capabilities such as the PingOne MCP server.

In this role, you will be a senior individual contributor helping design, build, test, and deploy scalable services and experiences that make it easier for prospects and customers to explore, adopt, and extend PingOne. What You Will Do: Report to the PingOne Admin Experience engineering director.

Serve as a senior individual contributor on the PingOne Platform Administration team. Participate in all stages of the software development life cycle, from requirements definition and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

Design and develop backend services and APIs that support the PingOne Platform Administration capabilities. Contribute to the development of AI-related platform tooling, including MCP server capabilities, developer tools, and supporting workflows.

Partner closely with product managers, QA, UX, and peer engineering teams across PingOne to deliver high-quality solutions. Help shape technical direction, engineering standards, and system design decisions within the team. Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day-to-day collaboration.

Support operational excellence by improving observability, reliability, maintainability, and deployment safety of team-owned services. What You Bring: 5-7+ years of professional software engineering experience, operating as a senior-level individual contributor on Agile teams.

Strong backend software development experience building production-grade services. 3+ years of experience developing Java services. Experience developing NodeJS services. Experience with TypeScript is highly desired. Experience in the Identity Management field is highly desired. Experience developing tools and skills for AI models is highly desired.

Experience developing MCP servers is highly desired. Experience developing SaaS applications. Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and working with distributed systems. Familiarity with cloud-native development practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production support.

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners including product management, QA, UX, and peer engineering teams. Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills. Skills valued on this team: Strong service-side engineering fundamentals and ability to own features end-to-end.

Experience working in small, fast-moving Agile squads with high ownership. Ability to balance near-term delivery with long-term maintainability. Comfort working across backend-heavy projects while collaborating with frontend, QA, product, and platform stakeholders.

Some frontend experience, or willingness to contribute outside a narrow backend lane when needed. Familiarity with CI/CD, test automation, and shipping safely to production. Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative environment with peers across PingOne platform teams.

Interest in platform capabilities, developer experience, and customer-facing admin workflows. Compensation Range: $110,218–$137,773 In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above.

About Enode
The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.
Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.
We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.
The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to make Enode’s EV platform more reliable, observable, and efficient.
As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Platform Connect team at Enode, you'll focus on improving the reliability, observability, and scalability of Enode's connectivity layer. This is the part of our API that aggregates integrations with EV chargers, vehicles, and OEM platforms into one cohesive and reliable product for our customers.
This is not an infrastructure or DevOps role. The Platform Connect team owns the product level platform that powers connectivity at Enode, maintaining and extending the layer that links our users to energy devices through consistent, high quality integrations.
You'll take on complex, critical for the business work and see it through, helping keep our platform robust as we scale to more OEMs and partners. Alongside the other senior engineers on the team, you'll help set the technical bar and support the people around you. Expect to move between hands on building, shaping technical direction, and helping teammates, depending on what the team needs most.
Our tech stack centers around a TypeScript based codebase combined with React, Node, AWS, Docker, and PostgreSQL, structured via CDK/CloudFormation.

Build and maintain API integrations with OEMs and energy partners, ensuring they are reliable, performant, and well tested.
Strengthen the connectivity platform by reducing incidents and improving observability, monitoring, and alerting, including the automations and internal tools that make this easier.
Take on complex projects and drive them through to release, breaking them into actionable work and delivering with limited hand-holding.
Help hold a high bar on code quality, testing, and observability, caring about the state of the codebase beyond your own changes.
Work with product and the team to align platform priorities, balancing stability with delivery.
Take ownership beyond your own work and support the engineers around you, sharing knowledge and contributing to technical decisions that keep the team aligned.

s.h: This role will be right for you, if
s.t:
See AI as a strategic lever for engineering work, not just a productivity add on. AI is a real part of how we work as engineers at Enode. We expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. Using it day to day, understanding where it helps and where it falls short, and thinking about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, we're looking for someone eager to get there fast. Additionally:
You have experience writing maintainable, testable backend code, ideally in an environment with a lot of API or integration work.
You're excited about platform engineering in the product sense. Building the connectivity layer that powers integrations, not managing infrastructure or CI/CD pipelines.
You enjoy building new integrations and making existing systems more reliable and observable, and you're systematic about debugging issues across services and preventing them from recurring.
You communicate clearly, contribute to technical discussions, and can explain complex topics to non technical stakeholders.
You take ownership beyond your own work and care about the team. You share knowledge, support teammates, and help improve how the team operates.

Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.
A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.
Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.
Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.
Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.
Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.
Flexible, human-first culture.
Stipend for setting up your home office.

Mittelstandsberatung ist ein operatives Geschäft. Jede Buchung, jede Lohnabrechnung, jede Steuererklärung folgt einem Prozess — und die Qualität dieser Prozesse bestimmt, ob ein Beratungsunternehmen mit fünfzig Mitarbeitern trägt oder mit fünfhundert. Die meisten Einheiten in unserer Branche haben diese Prozesse nie systematisch hinterfragt.

Sie funktionieren, weil erfahrene Menschen Workarounds kennen — nicht weil die Abläufe durchdacht sind. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an.

Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis — und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.
Du baust seit zwei bis fünf Jahren Workflows und Automatisierungen für interne Operatoren — in einer Workflow-Beratung, einer Automatisierungs-Agentur, als Internal Platform Engineer in einem Scaleup oder als Forward Deployed Engineer (intern).

Du hast mindestens fünf produktive Workflows live geschickt, die heute Stunden am Tag sparen — gemessen, dokumentiert, geowned. n8n, Make oder Claude Code sind dir hands-on vertraut, Python oder JavaScript auf Skript-Niveau gehören zu deinem Werkzeug, mindestens einen LLM-API hast du in Production verbaut.

Du wechselst, weil dir die Phase, in der du Workflows für ein Tech-Produkt baust, zu eng geworden ist — du willst denselben Hebel jetzt in einer Branche anwenden, in der jede Stunde Automatisierung direkten Mandantennutzen trägt.

Bei Vogel berichtest du direkt an die Geschäftsführung — Joachim und Moritz Vogel als sichtbare Personen, mit namentlicher Verantwortung — weil die Operations-Schicht hier neu aufgebaut wird. Strukturen, die tragen — etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis — und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Kein Konzern-Korsett. Kein Greenfield ohne Boden.
Du bist Hands-on Builder mit Aufbau-Verantwortung: rund 80 bis 90 Prozent deiner Zeit baust du selbst — Workflows, Integrationen, kleine interne Tools für die Vogel-Operatoren (Steuerberaterinnen, Steuerfachangestellte, Lohnbuchhalter, künftig auch Berater in Finance und Advisory).

Die übrigen 10 bis 20 Prozent baust du das Team auf: zwei bis drei Associates Automation & AI, die mit dir gemeinsam liefern. Du sprichst nicht direkt mit Mandanten — deine Nutzer sitzen intern. Du übernimmst die operative Exzellenz des Kerngeschäfts von Tag eins, in Rechnungswesen, Lohnbuchführung und Advisory.

Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach vierundzwanzig bis sechsunddreißig Monaten in eine Senior Manager Automation & AI-Rolle (Management-Karriere) mit Ownership über Prozessstandards, Automatisierung und operative Integration über alle Standorte.
Deine Verantwortung
Workflows bauen und in Production halten
Identifiziere die operativen Engpässe in den Vogel-Kernprozessen (Rechnungswesen, Lohnbuchführung, Advisory) über alle Standorte hinweg. Wo wartet ein Mensch auf einen anderen Menschen, wo erfasst jemand Daten doppelt, wo bricht der Prozess unter Stress?
Baue selbst in n8n, Make oder Claude Code die Workflows, die diese Engpässe wegnehmen. Dein Maßstab: produktiv laufend mit Error-Handling, Retry-Logik und Monitoring, nicht Konzept im Slide-Deck.
Etabliere Production-Disziplin von Tag eins: Test-Mandant vor Live-Mandant, versionierte Workflows, dokumentierte Verträge gegen DATEV, Personio und die Vogel-internen Systeme. Beim siebten Workflow darf nichts mehr schweigend brechen.

To qualify for the 2210 IT Specialist series, the applicant must demonstrate the following competencies: Attention to Detail (Level 4, Advanced) - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service (Level 4, Advanced) - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Decision Making (Level 3, Intermediate) - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.

Information Management (Level 4, Advanced) - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.

Interpersonal Skills (Level 4, Advanced) - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Oral Communication (Level 3, Intermediate) - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving (Level 4, Advanced) - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

Teamwork (Level 4, Advanced) - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence (Level 4, Advanced) - Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

Specialized Experience: Applicants must have specialized experience that is directly related to the work of the position and have equipped them with the competencies required to successfully perform the duties of the role.

These knowledge, skills, and abilities/competencies are normally attained through the equivalent of one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level of the position being filled. To qualify at the GS-14 level, you must have specialized experience at the GS-13 level, or equivalent.

This experience must demonstrate proficiency in the following: Experience with enterprise clientserver architecture, application design principles, and multiplatform software and hardware environments used in largescale production systems.

Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM), Intune, Azure device management, Windows Server Update Services (WSUS), PowerShell, SQL, and MSSQL to support full lifecycle application development, deployment, patching, and management.

Experience with AIdriven tools, automation technologies, and emerging advancements in artificial intelligence, with the ability to recommend strategies for integrating these capabilities into enterprise operations.

Experience analyzing and resolving highly complex technical problems related to software, hardware, and deployment infrastructures, including the development of sustainable solutions and technical documentation.

Experience coordinating and collaborating with business analysts, developers, QA teams, stakeholders, and vendors to deliver high quality, secure, maintainable software solutions.

About Fundraise Up
We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.
Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.
A Truly Global Product
We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.
We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals , admin tools , and several internal apps.
Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB . The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React , with nearly all code written in TypeScript . For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis) . Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse , and we use Elasticsearch for search.

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.
Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be a key contributor to our core product, building and scaling features that are central to the donation experience for millions of users. You'll leverage your expertise in Node.js, React, and TypeScript to develop complex components—from dynamic donation widgets to data-driven admin dashboards—with a relentless focus on code quality, scalability, and user experience.
This is an ideal opportunity if you love solving real-world problems at scale and want to grow within a mission-driven, high-impact engineering culture.

Join the FIA and play a key role in developing and monitoring the advanced technologies powering Formula 1.
As an Application Software Engineer within the FIA Technical Department, you will strengthen our in-house embedded software capabilities to implement, monitor, and enforce Formula 1 technical and sporting regulations. You will work on complex multi-system electronics projects requiring seamless integration across control units, sensors, communication networks, and data systems.
Based in Geneva, this new role requires working within a fast-paced, multidisciplinary team and includes trackside travel to Formula 1 events (approximately 12 events per year).

Embedded application software development
Design, implement, validate, and maintain robust in-house embedded software for key FIA Formula 1 platforms, notably the FIA Standard ECU and Accident Data Recorder, to monitor and enforce regulatory compliance.
Lead end-to-end multi-system integration across control units, sensors, vehicle communication buses, telemetry networks, and FIA data-analysis suites.
Translate complex sporting, technical, and operational requirements into high-integrity software architectures, detailed specifications, and rigorous verification plans.
Develop specialized simulation, test, and data-analysis tools to accelerate software validation, support regulatory evolution, and guarantee operational readiness.
Execute functional and integration testing on bench and vehicle environments in close collaboration with F1 teams, power unit manufacturers, and electronics suppliers.
Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain application software repositories, applying rigorous code reviews, version control, and clear technical documentation to ensure long-term reliability and maintainability.
Build and scale in-house engineering capabilities, reinforcing the FIA’s operational independence and responsiveness to emerging technical demands.
Auditing of electronic systems
Inspect competitors' embedded software, system behaviour, and telemetry data for compliance across chassis and powertrain regulations.
Develop automated auditing tools and liaise with suppliers to streamline electronic inspection and homologation workflows.
Development strategy and regulatory support
Support future regulation updates through proactive simulation, system modeling, and technical validation.
Define specifications for future FIA electronic architectures, safeguard FIA intellectual property, and contribute technical input to F1 working groups.
Race and test support
Provide trackside support at F1 races and tests (~12 events/year) to configure, operate, and monitor FIA electronics and data-logging systems.
Analyse real-time vehicle telemetry to verify regulatory compliance and resolve cross-system software anomalies in collaboration with teams and manufacturers.

Master’s degree in Electronics, Control Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 to 5 years of professional experience in embedded control systems or real-time application software development within a competitive motorsport environment (Formula 1, Formula E, WEC).
